fields.title: 8. Three data points to check directly before the next run
fields.md:
1. **FAA**: Whether a mishap investigation has been designated for Flight 15 (booster loss) and the Flight 16 license and schedule (source: item 1 of `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).
2. **Reason the booster was discontinued and Ship 42's condition after the catch**: one official SpaceX flight summary. Any accident during ground handling after the catch is recorded separately, and the verdict is not reversed (source: `state.definitions.ship_recovery.rule`).
3. **Existing checkpoints**: T7 ⓒ 11/19 · T2 12/8 lockup · T12 12/9 vote · Tesla merger 8-K (T6) · monthly 12/01 (source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
